title: SB110 (2024 Regular): void covenants that prohibit or restrict the possession or use of firearms and ammunition.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (South Dakota) (gun-policy Stage 5, South Dakota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Dakota text (Introduced, 2024-01-20; official copy, https://mylrc.sdlegislature.gov/api/Documents/261062.pdf (sdlegislature.gov DocumentId 261062, BillId 25145))
provenance.note: Introduced text, 2024-01-20. No passage vote recorded.

operative_text: Section 1 (new section in SDCL ch. 43-12): A covenant running with the land may not prohibit, restrict, or have the effect of prohibiting or restricting: (1) The lawful possession, storing, or transportation of a firearm, any part of a firearm, or ammunition; or (2) The lawful discharge of a firearm. Any covenant in violation of this section, including one enacted before July 1, 2024, is void and unenforceable.
